u1.chain.02.zh-CN: 逐项对照签名目标、批准时快照与当前证据。影响传播仅为依赖图提示；参考判定不授予权限，所有派发仍由冻结网关裁决。
u1.chain.02.en: Compare signed goals, approval snapshots and current evidence. Propagation is a dependency-graph hint. Research judgments grant no authority; the frozen gateway still decides every dispatch.

u1.chain.03.zh-CN: 已消费 token 不能再次使用。已结算节点的哈希变化只作历史对照，不表示撤销结算；定时节点执行时使用现有 SPA 路径重新检查。研究口径保留政策、业务日、对象及档位不变，排除财务版本与余额原值相等；缺少批准时证据时明确不判定。
u1.chain.03.en: Consumed tokens cannot be reused. Changes on settled nodes are historical comparisons and do not reverse settlement. Scheduled execution is rechecked through the existing SPA path. This conservative research contract retains policy, business date, object and tier equality, while excluding financial-version and exact-balance equality. Missing approval evidence is not evaluated.

u1.chain.09.zh-CN: 第 6 次请求会触发既有安全锁，所以可执行剩余按上限减 1 计算。预检为只读提示，不预留额度、不改变审批或政策；并发操作和后续状态变化仍可能停止本链。
u1.chain.09.en: The sixth request triggers the existing safety lock, so spendable capacity is limit minus one. This read-only preflight reserves no capacity and changes no approval or policy. Concurrent operations and later state changes may still stop the chain.

u1.chain.11.zh-CN: 推进的是现有模拟时钟；待输入验证码在 120 秒后过期，连续按 6 次会让登录过期；到期订阅、已授权定时任务和到期赎回也会由网关处理或结算。
u1.chain.11.en: The existing simulated clock advances. Pending codes expire after 120 seconds; six consecutive clicks expire the login. Due subscriptions, authorized schedules and due redemptions are also processed or settled by the gateway.

u1.chain.12.zh-CN: 未保留批准时状态；不推断许可是否仍成立
u1.chain.12.en: Approval-time state was not retained; no inference about continuing permission.

u1.chain.13.en: Exclude financial-version and exact-balance equality; retain policy, business date, objects, tier and credential preconditions.
